profile.summary: saiwong is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in maintaining and optimizing jQuery’s core functionality, particularly focused on legacy browser compatibility (IE ≤8). Their contributions demonstrate deep knowledge of DOM manipulation quirks, legacy event handling patterns, and performance optimizations within jQuery’s internals. While their experience is heavily centered on jQuery and older browser environments, their ability to debug subtle DOM and event inconsistencies highlights strong foundational JavaScript skills. No evidence of modern JavaScript frameworks or ecosystems (e.g., React, Node.js) is present in their contributions.

PR #2: Removed redundant window.event checks, a common pattern in IE < 9 event handling, showing familiarity with deprecated browser behaviors.

PR #3: Refactored before/after/replaceWith to avoid pushStack, indicating performance optimizations in jQuery’s core DOM manipulation methods.
PR #3: Optimized DOM method chaining to reduce memory usage, suggesting internal knowledge of jQuery’s stack-based DOM manipulation system.
All PRs: Focused exclusively on jQuery’s core DOM and event handling, with no involvement in modern JavaScript frameworks or tooling.
